headline: 1Password says an attacker copied some customers' names, emails and account details from its backend; it says vaults were not affected.
summary: New incident page. Read 1Password's incident post (Nov 25) and TechCrunch (Nov 25). Main answer Confirmed and answer_group hack-stated: 1Password itself says an attacker gained access to backend systems. incident_type breach: customer account data was copied. No service: 1Password says its apps and services are working normally, and nothing is reported down. The vault claim is the company's word alone, so Reported. Open: how many customers, how the GitHub account was taken over, who did it. Privacy check done: no people named; the support address in the post is left out.
author: Research agent
